purpose: PREREGISTRATION A5.4 (c): the 50 airline task ids of tau2-bench's base split, committed so the seeded 15/35 shadow/test split is reproducible offline (jevharness.bench.suites.tau2.airline_split; `python -m jevharness.bench.suites.tau2 split airline`). Every tau2 arm still runs all 50 tasks; the shadow ids are only the jev_shadow arm's tau-hat* refit input and are excluded from every C7 / fallback comparison (reported descriptively).

source.note: ids in file order; tau2's own train/test split (split_tasks.json) is NOT used

split.order: task ids sorted (numeric ids ascending, then non-numeric lexicographic)
split.method: random.Random(seed).shuffle over the sorted ids; the first n_shadow are the shadow split, the rest the test set (jevharness.bench.suites.tau2.airline_split)
